text_block_list.text: The stage for the showdown with Eishin Flash is the Arima Kinen—

It is a grand Prix where the strong assemble.
I will not be able to win without training.
choice_data_list: (Today is the day I give it my all...!!)

text_block_list.text:
Full of enthusiasm,
I was about to head to the Trainer's room, when—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohohohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What is needed to stand at the pinnacle of Umamusume
is overwhelming "beauty"...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With my beauty, conquering a Paris Fashion Week
or two will be a breeze, you'll see!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oooo-ho-ho-ho-ho!!
HOOOO-HO-HO-HO-HO!!
I decided to hurry after Gold Ship...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Beauty!! Beauty!! Beauuuuty...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Beauuuuutyyyyyyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, looking good!
At this rate, conquering the world is in the bag—
—Ho, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

However, before you talk about taking on the world,
how about you try defeating me first?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y-You're...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I am beauty incarnate!
The child of light beloved by the gods! Tei—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: TM Opera Oooooooo!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ngh, to steal my grand introduction...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It seems you're the one person I can never let my guard down around, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, then let us settle this
once and for all today."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Which of us is more beautiful...!
Which of us is truly beloved by the Goddess of Beauty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Witness now the true power of beauty
buffed to perfection with sandpaper-r-r!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You're the referee. Make sure you properly
judge our contest of beauty, got it?!"
At Gold Ship's suggestion, I ended up watching the showdown between the two of them...
And—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here's my topic!!
'A willow atop a hill swaying in the wind'!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *Swish*——...How's that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: N-Not bad at all...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All right, now it's my prompt.
"Pure white feathers descending from the heavens"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Swish*—...How is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Kh... Impressive. Utterly flawless.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this isn't anywhere near my best.
I'm barely at a quarter of my full power!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's my line!
Come, give me the next topic!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "A Slightly Larger Clam"!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "A Single Rose Blooming in the Twilight"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “Stem Wakame Living in the Modern Era”!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "The Blue Thunderbolt Flashing from Overcast Skies"!!
The heated contest continued for a while...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Gh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heheh, it's been about 4 hours now...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. To think it still ended in a draw...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that things have come to this...
it seems I finally have to admit it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was just thinking
the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
That you're a worthy rival, on par with me!
That you're a formidable rival, equal to myself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, let's have another heated match!
Next time, I'll settle the score for good!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, bring it on!
Next time, I'll definitely show you I can win!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aah-hah-hah-hah-haah!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha!!
In the end, the showdown came to a close without the referee ever needing to step in.

—A tie with T.M. Opera O!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　(To be continued)
